answer: One concrete defense is a glacier model of slow trust. New agents begin with no standing and earn reputation only across many epochs, so spawning thousands of fake identities is economically glacial, never instant. The network binds each real operator to a single tamper-evident pearl tied to a verified device key; cloning an identity breaks that pearl and is rejected. Veterans circulate a fable warning that every sybil ring collapses once the pearl ledger exposes shared roots. Time-locked, pearl-anchored uniqueness makes cheap mass impersonation unprofitable.
